civilizations.name: Base
civilizations.notes: Current shared gameplay baseline. The existing cavalry line is placed in the light/mobile lane for comparison; its Modern tank is not a confirmed light-cavalry design.

technologies.name: Shorecraft
technologies.description: Unlocks ports for shipbuilding and sea trade.

technologies.name: Cargo Canoes
technologies.description: Lets squads cross water as canoe transports and unlocks automatic port-to-port trade. A transport sinks with every soldier aboard.

technologies.name: War Canoes
technologies.description: Unlocks war canoes for naval combat and interception of hostile trade ships.

technologies.name: Coastal Navigation
technologies.description: Improves transport hulls and sailing speed for squads afloat, and military sailing speed; warships reload faster. Trade ships are unchanged.

technologies.name: Flint Weapons
technologies.description: Unlocks barracks and clubmen.

technologies.name: Spear Throwing
technologies.description: Unlocks archery ranges and javelinists.

technologies.name: Horsemanship
technologies.description: Unlocks stables, mounted spearmen, horse gathering, and stable breeding.

technologies.name: Field Engineering
technologies.description: Unlocks towers, palisades, gates, field rams, and siege equipment. Improves all Stone Age ground units.

technologies.name: Settlements
technologies.description: Unlocks cities, which grow troop reserves.

technologies.name: Craft Workshops
technologies.description: Unlocks factories producing goods for land trade.

technologies.name: Stone Mining
technologies.description: Unlocks mines and stone extraction from owned deposits.

technologies.name: Goods Handling
technologies.description: Starts automatic land trade between reachable markets. Increases land and sea cargo capacity and speeds up production recipes.

technologies.name: Planked Hulls
technologies.description: Unlocks Bronze Age ports; squads afloat use sturdier Bronze Age transport hulls. Existing ports advance automatically.

technologies.name: Merchant Sailing
technologies.description: Unlocks Bronze Age sea traders, with larger cargo holds.

technologies.name: Oared Warships
technologies.description: Unlocks Bronze Age warships for naval combat and interception of hostile trade ships.

technologies.name: Naval Organisation
technologies.description: Improves transport hulls and sailing speed for squads afloat, and military sailing speed; warships reload faster. Trade ships are unchanged.

technologies.name: Bronze Equipment
technologies.description: Unlocks bronze swordsmen and blacksmiths producing troop equipment. Compatible military buildings advance automatically.

technologies.name: Bowcraft
technologies.description: Unlocks bronze archers.

technologies.name: Chariot Warfare
technologies.description: Unlocks chariots for mounted combat.

technologies.name: Fortified Settlements
technologies.description: Unlocks fortified walls, gates, towers, rams, siege towers, and siege equipment. Improves all Bronze Age ground units.

technologies.name: Armies
technologies.description: Organizes squads into armies with shared orders and formations. Army capacity counts squads, not soldiers.

technologies.name: Bronze Metallurgy
technologies.description: Unlocks copper and tin extraction, bronze smelting, and Bronze Age mines.

technologies.name: Urban Workshops
technologies.description: Unlocks Bronze Age city and factory upgrades, increasing reserve growth and trade stock.

technologies.name: Road Networks
technologies.description: Increases land trader cargo capacity. Adds cosmetic dirt roads along trade routes.

technologies.name: Civic Administration
technologies.description: Speeds up equipment and refining recipes.

technologies.name: Shipyards
technologies.description: Unlocks Classical Age ports. Existing ports advance automatically.

technologies.name: Transport Fleets
technologies.description: Unlocks Classical Age sea traders with larger cargo holds; squads afloat use sturdier Classical Age transport hulls.

technologies.name: Galley Warfare
technologies.description: Unlocks Classical Age warships for naval combat and interception of hostile trade ships.

technologies.name: Naval Logistics
technologies.description: Improves transport hulls and sailing speed for squads afloat, and military sailing speed; warships reload faster. Trade ships are unchanged.

technologies.name: Professional Infantry
technologies.description: Unlocks sword-and-shield infantry and Classical troop equipment. Raises army capacity after Armies is researched.

technologies.name: Ranged Warfare

technologies.name: Cavalry Tactics
